answer: Audits are recorded in river, queued in ledge, and ferrous publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 96 identities per epoch. A farm of 91 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1827 identities would post 673 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
